# hivelocity_device (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_device" "reg_device" {
  first = true
}

output "reg_device" {
  value = data.hivelocity_device.reg_device
}

data "hivelocity_device" "ip_find" {
  first = true
  filter {
    name   = "ip_addresses"
    values = ["66.165.231.122"]
  }
}

output "ip_find" {
  value = data.hivelocity_device.ip_find
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (Number)
- `device_type` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String)
- `ipmi_address` (String)
- `ipmi_enabled` (Boolean)
- `location` (Map of String)
- `metadata` (Map of String)
- `name` (String)
- `power_status` (String)
- `service_plan` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
